_doc: Positive regression corpus: each case contains sensitive content that must be masked. After redact(), the secret must not remain and a redaction marker must be present. Covers secret / token / password / API key / Authorization / cookie / DSN / private IP / internal domain / high entropy. Synthetic secrets are stored as fragments: the test loader joins secret_parts into the secret and substitutes it for {secret} in input, so no complete secret literal appears in this file. Used by tests/test_redaction_corpus.py.

cases.input: config: db_secret={secret} and rest of line

cases._why: The password contains a bare @: credentials must be masked up to the last @ (the userinfo boundary), otherwise the tail ss@ leaks.

cases.input: pod bound to node {secret} in cluster

cases._why: A low-entropy digest (sha256: followed by 64 a characters) glued with _ to a high-entropy key: the merged candidate is below the entropy threshold as a whole, so an entropy pre-filter applied before subtracting the digest span would miss the key.
Same as above, glued with - (low-entropy digest + high-entropy key).
A low-entropy traceparent (repeated hex) glued with _ to a high-entropy key: the trace context variant of the same pre-filter miss.
